---
address: norway.geo.postalCode
description: Every Norwegian postal code (postnummer) that a street address can actually carry — 3378 of them, taken from the official Posten/Bring postnummerregister and filtered to the two categories that serve delivery addresses (B, street addresses only; G, street addresses and PO boxes). The register holds 5 122 codes in all; the 1 740 dropped here are PO-box-only codes and 4 are service codes, and putting one of those on a street address is exactly the kind of value that passes every format check and is undeliverable. Four digits with the leading zero kept — 0150 is an Oslo code and 150 is nothing — and the range in use runs 0001 (OSLO) to 9991 (BÅTSFJORD), climbing roughly south-east to north, but it is FULL OF GAPS, which is why this is a real list rather than a 0001..9991 pattern — of the 9 991 codes the format allows, only about half have ever been issued. Source: Bring postnummerregister (postnummer, poststed, kommunenummer, kommune, kategori), the file Posten publishes for public use.
